module.purpose: This test module verifies that unknown server errors are converted into HTTP errors with the correct status, message, cause, and attached data.
module.summary: The file exercises an error-normalization utility across Stripe-shaped errors, coded errors, plain errors, server-only error codes, and grouped HTTP status mappings. It uses Vitest assertions to protect preservation of error metadata and the classification of known client, missing-resource, conflict, and unexpected failures.
module.businessContext: This supports API error handling for booking, payment, scheduling, and authentication workflows. Incorrect mappings expose internal failures or return misleading HTTP responses to clients.

io: Registers and executes Vitest test cases.
mutationOfArg: Sets the prototype of the locally constructed Stripe-shaped error object to Error.prototype.

edgeCases.inputShape: Stripe-shaped invalid request error with nested raw metadata
edgeCases.behavior: Converts to HttpError status 400 while preserving message and original cause.

edgeCases.inputShape: ErrorWithCode containing a Date and attendee collection
edgeCases.behavior: Returns status 400 and preserves the structured data property.

edgeCases.inputShape: Plain Error whose message is a known client ErrorCode
edgeCases.behavior: Applies the same known-code status mapping as ErrorWithCode and returns 409.

edgeCases.inputShape: Generic Error with an unrecognized message
edgeCases.behavior: Falls back to status 500 while retaining the error message.

edgeCases.inputShape: ErrorWithCode using a server-side OAuth creation code
edgeCases.behavior: Returns status 500 with the supplied failure message.

edgeCases.inputShape: Each enumerated 400, 404, or 409 domain error code
edgeCases.behavior: Generates an assertion enforcing the expected HTTP classification.

invariants.description: Stripe invalid request errors produce an HttpError with status code 400.
Structured data attached to ErrorWithCode remains equal after conversion.
Known client error codes map to status code 400.
Known missing-resource codes map to status code 404.
Known conflict and capacity codes map to status code 409.
Unknown generic errors and server-side coded errors map to status code 500.

assumptions.description: Imported ErrorCode values determine the utility's client, missing-resource, conflict, and server-side classifications.
The tested conversion utility returns an object exposing statusCode and message properties.
Vitest provides describe, test, and expect during test execution.

concurrencyModel.notes: Tests construct independent error objects and synchronously invoke the conversion utility.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A StripeInvalidRequestError-like object is converted into an HttpError.
given: const stripeError = { name: "StripeInvalidRequestError", type: "StripeInvalidRequestError", rawType: "invalid_request_error", message: "No such customer: cus_12345; a valid customer ID is required.", statusCode: 400 }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the original error as the cause while mapping Stripe request failures to HTTP 400.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An ErrorWithCode carrying rescheduling data is converted without losing its data property.
given: const rescheduleData = { rescheduleUid: "abc123", startTime: new Date("2024-01-15T10:00:00Z"), attendees: [{ name: "John Doe", email: "john@example.com" }] }
const error = new ErrorWithCode(ErrorCode.BookerLimitExceededReschedule, "Maximum booking limit reached, please reschedule an existing booking", rescheduleData)
moduleContractTests.then: expect(result.statusCode).toBe(400); expect(result.message).toBe("Maximum booking limit reached, please reschedule an existing booking"); expect(result.data).toEqual(rescheduleData)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards propagation of structured error metadata alongside status and message mapping.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A plain Error whose message is a client-facing ErrorCode is mapped like an ErrorWithCode.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures recognized error codes are inferred from plain Error messages.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A generic Error without a recognized ErrorCode becomes an internal server error.
given: const error = new Error("Some unexpected server error")
moduleContractTests.rationale: Protects the fallback status for unexpected server failures.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An ErrorWithCode using a server-side ErrorCode returns status 500.
given: const error = new ErrorWithCode(ErrorCode.CreatingOauthClientError, "OAuth client creation failed")
moduleContractTests.rationale: Separates server-side codes from client-facing HTTP status mappings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Each listed client request ErrorCode is converted to HTTP 400.
given: const error = new ErrorWithCode(errorCode, `Test message for ${errorCode}`)

moduleContractTests.scenario: Each listed not-found ErrorCode is converted to HTTP 404.
given: const error = new ErrorWithCode(errorCode, `Test message for ${errorCode}`)

moduleContractTests.scenario: Each listed conflict ErrorCode is converted to HTTP 409.
given: const error = new ErrorWithCode(errorCode, `Test message for ${errorCode}`)
